metadata.populationProfileInterpretation: Four mutually exclusive groups; mobilityImpaired includes all ages and is excluded from the other three groups. Round agent counts within each building to preserve occupancy.
metadata.occupancyInterpretation: People present at this snapshot, not registered residents. Generate each person once from building occupancy, including occupants of shelter buildings.
metadata.shelterCapacityInterpretation: Total simultaneous capacity, not initially available spaces. Initial shelter occupancy is zero; occupants of associated buildings consume capacity when admitted.
metadata.roadInterpretation: All edges are bidirectional. Travel from each building center to its nearestRoadNode, and from shelter roadNode to shelter position, includes the access distance.
metadata.groundZoneBoundaryRule: Use min-inclusive, max-exclusive bounds; include the outer city boundary at 1000. Ground y is zero everywhere.
metadata.riskInterpretation: All resistance, risk, intensity, amplification and probability values are synthetic educational parameters, not engineering or casualty predictions.
metadata.collapseThresholdInterpretation: Normalized accumulated structural damage triggering collapse, not a direct ground-intensity threshold.
metadata.evacuationDelayInterpretation: evacuationDelaySeconds is the baseline delay after shaking ends, before outdoor evacuation begins; subsequent movement and queueing are additional.
metadata.groundIntensityInterpretation: Subtract intensityFalloff times epicentral distance in meters from baseIntensity, then multiply by shakingAmplification and clamp to [0,1].
metadata.scenarioProbabilityInterpretation: aftershockProbability is sampled once for one possible aftershock within 600 seconds after the main shock. fireIgnitionProbability is the baseline per-building ignition chance sampled once per main shock, before material and damage modifiers.
